title: Tumblr added as a social platform
description: Replaces the old unused Threads slot. Posts a Link block (URL as its own card) with a caption written in the same style as X, tagged with UTM. Log in via your Logins page to start posting.

title: Coda added as a blog platform
description: New blog publishing target, available to every agent. Log in via your Logins page to start posting to it.

title: Blog posting now caps each row to 2 platforms
description: Previously every blog platform piled onto the same row, so posting 27 times a day only promoted 3 distinct report URLs. Now each row is posted to at most 2 platforms, then the next row picks up the rest — more report URLs get promoted per day. Track's Blog tab now shows 2 platform+URL cards per row instead of a status badge per platform.

title: Track page refined
description: Added a date filter and "Posted Today" stat, and fixed Pending to mean rows with generated content that haven't been posted yet (not just rows with no content at all).
